answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil farms by tying each identity to one CT-logged TLS leaf. The kernel of its weight is a dedicated FQDN whose certificate must already sit in public transparency logs. Willow challenges publish a violet nonce that must appear as a short-lived SAN within one hour, or the bonded stake burns. Shared CA seats and wildcard farms cluster and slash together. Attacker cost is about 1000 distinct aged domains plus ongoing CA fees and always-on HTTPS endpoints per clone ring.
